use: What each farm's field grows (sim/goods/crops.ts, drawn by world/art/crop-art.ts). A farm (sim/map/ladder/dress.ts) picks one crop from the crops whose biomeIds meet the fabric biomes of the ground in and around it (coarse biome -> fabric biome: fabric). Each crop turns through the stages over yearDays, shifted by its sow offset, so the fields of one road ripen at different times. Gleaning a field (props.json field verb) takes glean x itemId at that stage; a stage with glean 0 has nothing to take. name is shown on the field's prompt.

stages.name: new-sown
stages.done: Only bare drills and a few green tips. Nothing to take yet.

stages.name: growing
stages.done: You thin the rows and keep what you pull.

stages.name: ripe
stages.done: Heavy and ready: the field edge gives a good armful.

stages.name: cut
stages.done: You glean what the harvest left behind.
